subject: Clarify PO XML schema / Coupa validation failures
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: coupa-validation@hearthwell.com
Date: 2026-10-25T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation

Hi Jordan,

We attempted to accept your vendor submission in our Coupa instance earlier this morning and the XML rejected during schema validation. The validator flagged missing required nodes (billTo/address/line1) and an unexpected 'invoiceParty' element under OrderHeader. I've attached the Coupa validation log and our PO_Spec_v2.xml for reference.

Can your integration team confirm which PO schema/version Redwood is exporting? We need a clear mapping for:
- billTo vs shipTo semantics
- invoiceParty vs billTo (we saw both in your sample)
- currency and tax nodes placement

We'd like to get this resolved this week if possible — Hearthwell's procurement ops are aiming for a soft go-live on 11/03.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Procurement Manager | Hearthwell Pharma
Samantha Ortiz
Attachment: PO_Spec_v2.xml (application/xml)
Attachment: coupa_validation_log.txt (text)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick heads up and the logs.

Short answer: our exporter can emit both styles (billTo-centric or invoiceParty-centric) but the default mapping for Coupa should be billTo. It sounds like an earlier test payload slipped with the invoiceParty element included.

Can you confirm the exact schema/canonical XSD version Coupa is enforcing on your tenant (we saw references to v1.7 in the log)? Two quick asks from our side:
1) Could you share the failing XML example (the actual payload that hit your validator) so we can replicate locally?
2) Do you require the billTo block to always include full address lines (street/line1/line2) or is a billing-code reference acceptable?

I'll loop Karthik for PO/order routing details and Priyom for a quick check on the Order Form / MSA implications — we want to make sure we don't break any invoicing terms in the contract while we change the mapping.

Proposed next step: 30-minute tech sync tomorrow (10/26) to align on the final mapping and sign off on the go-live checklist. Are you available between 9–11am PT?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation

Samantha — quick mapping note from our integration team:
- Our current payloads include both 'billTo' and an optional 'invoiceParty' (invoiceParty used only for marketplace scenarios).
- We can toggle to emit billTo-only payloads for Hearthwell; would that avoid the validation error?
- For tax nodes we place taxes under OrderHeader/Taxes; if Hearthwell needs Taxes under LineItem we can adapt but will need 24–48 hours for a minor release.

Jordan — regarding the Order Form, the only contract impact I see is the invoice delivery clause (Order Form section 2.3) that currently names a billing contact by name and address. If Hearthwell requires invoices to be delivered to an alternate system or a different billing entity (invoiceParty), legal will need to bless that. Priyom — any immediate blocker here?

-Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation (MSA redline attached)

On Tue, Oct 25, 2026 at 10:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> (quoted above)

Jordan / team — I pulled the relevant Order Form language and attached a redline that highlights the billing/invoice party area (MSA_redline_20261020.pdf). Two quick items:
1) If Hearthwell simply wants the invoice to point to a different billing address within the XML (billing address text change), that's operational and we can proceed without contract changes.
2) If Hearthwell intends to change the invoice *recipient* (i.e., a separate legal entity appears as invoiceParty), that is a material change to the Order Form and will need an approved redline. That would push beyond the 11/03 soft go-live unless we accept invoices at the original billing entity and route copies to the new party.

Recommendation: proceed with billTo-only payloads now and plan legal language to support a separate invoice party as a post-go-live amendment. I'll prepare a short two-line amendment we can sign (DocuSign link pending) so procurement can accept that as a mitigation.

-Priyom Das
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_redline_20261020.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: coupa-validation@hearthwell.com, vendor-ops@coupa.com
Date: 2026-10-27T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation

Thanks for the quick follow-ups, all. We attached a sanitized example of the failing payload (Coupa_sample_PO_20261024.xml) and our portal credential instructions (portal_credentials_instructions.pdf) for your integration team.

Notes:
- We are OK starting with billTo-only payloads as a pragmatic path to go-live.
- Hearthwell will accept invoices sent to the original billing entity for 30 days post-launch while we finalize any legal amendment to support an alternate invoiceParty.
- We can join the 10/26 sync at 9:30am PT.

Coupa contact (vendor-ops) is looped for any tenant-side quirks — vendor-ops@coupa.com.

Samantha Ortiz
Procurement Manager | Hearthwell Pharma
Attachments: Coupa_sample_PO_20261024.xml (application/xml); portal_credentials_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@hearthwell.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding - PO XML failing validation

Samantha / team — great, thanks for the alignment. Quick recap and next steps from Redwood's side:

Action items:
- Integration: Karthik to push billTo-only exporter and run validation against Coupa_sample_PO_20261024.xml (target: 10/29 end of day).
- Legal: Priyom to draft the two-line amendment to allow separate invoiceParty and circulate for signature (DocuSign link to follow).
- Ops: Jordan to confirm go-live window and canary customers — we will do a 48-hour canary with 10% of POs routed to the new flow.

Please confirm if you want Redwood to perform the validation tests from our staging tenant against your tenant, or if you'll run them on your side. We can own the test run if you provide a test credential per the portal instructions.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with these tasks and mark the go/no-go timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
